provenance.description: R gmm reference for the emu-gmm multi-asset Euler (Hansen-Singleton) cross-check
provenance.model: psi_j = beta*(c_next/c_t)^(-gamma)*(1+r_j)-1, j=1..3; M=3, K=2, over_id=1
provenance.note: emu-gmm and gmm agree to ~5-6 significant figures on this nonlinear fit (tighter than the linear-IV case: at the over-identified optimum the moment mean is ~0, so the centered-vs-uncentered covariance gap nearly vanishes). Both reference J to chi^2_1.
